style.description: Polished flat 2D mobile game illustration with rounded geometric forms and clean soft outlines. Calm, modern and suitable for ages 3–16 without looking preschoolish.

singleObject.prompt: One complete {subject}, centered, isolated, consistent scale, focus-planet-soft-2d-v1 style, intended for {ageBand}, {background}, no text, no watermark, no cropped silhouette.

spotDifference.prompt: Two equal side-by-side panels of {scene}, identical framing with exactly {differenceCount} deliberate differences suitable for {ageBand}. Differences may use color, missing object, direction, shape or count. No microscopic differences, text or watermark.

forestSearchBoard.prompt: A calm forest clearing containing exactly {targets}, with every target fully visible and enough empty space for touch hotspots. Landscape focus-planet-soft-2d-v1 style suitable for {ageBand}; no text, watermark, microscopic targets or dense clutter.

mascotPose.prompt: Space fox mascot in {pose}, showing {emotion}, preserve approved character identity and costume, {background}, no additional characters, text or watermark.
